sloka: हिरण्मयैः च करकैर् भाजनैः स्फाटिकैर् अपि ।जाम्बूनदमयैश्चान्याः करकैरभिवम्वृता ॥५-११-२२॥
transliteration: hiraṇmayaiḥ ca karakair bhājanaiḥ sphāṭikair api ।jāmbūnadamayaiścānyāḥ karakairabhivamvṛtā ॥5-11-22॥

translations.english: (The banquet hall) appeared beautiful with many kinds of garlands arranged in different locations. Also there were vessels made of pure gold, crystalware and jars spread all over.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने उन नागकन्याश्रों को देखा जिन्हें रावण बलपूर्वक हर लाया | था, किन्तु जनकनन्दिनी नहीं दिखाई पड़ीं
